verdict.rationale: Exa explicitly markets token-efficient extraction (10x token efficient, recommended 4000-char chunks) designed for LLM context, plus structured JSON output via output_schema and a specialized model for extracting relevant excerpts, all directly aimed at RAG pipelines; it also offers a web_search tool wrapper for agent loops. Missing for 10: independent benchmark of context quality/ranking accuracy in a real RAG pipeline and more detail on result truncation/ranking tuning beyond docs claims.
